# Agent Memory: Pin Health

Standing feedback for `agent-pin-health` runs. The workflow loads this file into the agent's prompt on every run, after the controller, and the controller reads the Held pins section to skip bumps you've already decided to hold. Keep durable guidance here. One-off instructions and single-run logs belong in the PR.

## Held Pins

The controller parses each bullet in this exact form: - `package` held at <major> (unit): reason
